usage: Fictional illustrative concepts, not commissioned client work

assets.name: packaging
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one premium landscape 3:2 editorial product photograph for a Tunisian creative agency portfolio concept. Fictional olive oil brand 'ZÉRA', exact simple text ZÉRA on labels. Three sculptural dark green glass olive oil bottles, ivory labels with bold forest-green modern serif type, gold caps, small printed green and ivory packaging boxes, one natural olive branch and a few olives. Beautiful warm ivory plinths with curved arch, warm direct Mediterranean light and tactile shadows, art-directed contemporary brand design, expensive and believable real product photography. Mostly forest green #08443a, pale cream #fffaf0, golden olive accents. Product occupies center 75%, clean and memorable composition. No real client logos, no watermarks, no website UI, no collage.

assets.name: campaign

assets.name: event
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Landscape 3:2 environmental photograph of an imagined premium brand launch event in a Mediterranean outdoor courtyard at blue hour. A beautifully constructed deep forest green sculptural stage with warm gold lighting, illuminated arch, gold overhead fabric and green abstract identity, subtle fictional word 'RENCONTRES' on stage. Audience naturally seen from behind in the lower edge, small groups of guests, no recognizable faces or celebrities, documentary feeling, no posed stock office group. Strong architectural image, rich deep green, cream stone, amber lighting. Agency portfolio illustrative concept, no real brands or watermark.
